_notes: THE ACTION ROSTER. Chapter 1 ships fourteen skills plus the instinct,
four to a humour and two for Moonlight, and the loadout holds five --
so a night out is a CHOICE about which cat Ash is going to be tonight
rather than a bar that fills up.
Each humour is a job, and a skill that does another humour's job is a
skill nobody picks:
FEROCITY  hurts things. Swat is the rate, Pounce is the swing, Rake
opens a seam for the next blow, and Bite goes THROUGH a
raised guard (the only player answer to a `block` intent).
GUILE     keeps him going. Purr mends, Loaf holds the line and is the
one guard against theft, Scrounge buys a turn's worth of
hand, Shelf Justice is patience cashed in at once.
SHADOW    refuses the exchange. Slink turns a hit, Shade turns two,
Unknot undoes what an unraveller picked, and Vanish is the
Stalk approach taken in the middle of the fight.
MOONLIGHT does what none of the others can. It is hers, it is wild,
and it is rare -- there are three Moonlight cards in the
starting spool and the Magpie charges double for more, so a
one-Moonlight cost is already an expensive sentence.
Costs keyed `mysticism` are the REVERSE of the wild rule: only true
Moonlight pays them (combat_state.gd WILD_HUMOUR). That is what makes
Moonwise and Her Hour feel like her work and not like everyone's.
Where each one is LEARNED is in data/quests.json -- a notice step at
the moment the quest earns it. Nothing here is bought.
NAMES ARE A LAYOUT CONSTRAINT, not only writing. The action card is 132
wide and the carried fan OVERLAPS its cards (five of them do not fit
across 582px of page), so a name has roughly nine characters before it
starts disappearing under its neighbour. Three of these shipped as `Bite
Down`, `Long Shadow` and `Her Thread` and were measured, not eyeballed:
tests/unit/test_typography.gd now fails a name that cannot be drawn.

scratch.name: Scratch
scratch.flavor: Always available. Rarely sufficient. Deeply satisfying.

pounce.name: Pounce
pounce.flavor: The wiggle first. The wiggle is non-negotiable.

swat.name: Swat
swat.flavor: Measured. Judicial. Off the shelf it goes.

rake.name: Rake
rake.flavor: Four lines, close together. He finds them later, in better light.

bite_down.name: Bite
bite_down.flavor: A guard is a thing held in front. I am not going at the front.

slink.name: Slink
slink.flavor: You saw a cat. You saw no such cat.

unknot.name: Unknot
unknot.flavor: Whatever it tangled, I can untangle. It takes longer than the tangling.

long_shadow.name: Shade
long_shadow.flavor: Cast once, early, and it does the rest of the evening's work.

vanish.name: Vanish
vanish.flavor: Be somewhere else before anybody has decided where you are.

purr.name: Purr
purr.flavor: Self-repair, audible from the next room.

loaf.name: Loaf
loaf.flavor: Nothing loose. Nothing to take. All paws accounted for.

scrounge.name: Scrounge
scrounge.flavor: Nothing in this city is finished with until I have been over it.

shelf_justice.name: Shelf Justice
shelf_justice.flavor: It was already broken when gravity got there.

moonwise.name: Moonwise
moonwise.flavor: She could tell what a thing meant to do by how it stood. I am slower.

her_thread.name: Her Hour
her_thread.flavor: She always had one more minute in her than the clock was offering.
